يستوئر (form X)
# يَسْتَوْئِرُ (yastawʔiru) /jas.taw.ʔi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْأَرَ (istawʔara) and اِسْتَوْءَرَ (istawʔara)
# يَسْتَوْئِرَ (yastawʔira) /jas.taw.ʔi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْأَرَ (istawʔara) and اِسْتَوْءَرَ (istawʔara)
# يَسْتَوْئِرْ (yastawʔir) /jas.taw.ʔir/: third-person mascul
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
